summary: Added conflict-safe CalDAV update: PUT to an existing resource now requires If-Match, enforces EditAnyEvent authorization (404, no disclosure), rejects stale/missing preconditions with 412 without mutation, routes the update through EventService with the observed version for atomicity, and rotates the ETag on success.
follow_up: Update path only supports timed, non-recurring events (consistent with T07 create); all-day and recurrence updates are out of scope per the packet and will be covered by T13/T14.
important_context: The PUT handler (handle_put_event_resource) is now a dispatcher: existing resource -> handle_put_update_event_resource (If-Match required), missing resource -> handle_put_create_event_resource (If-None-Match: * required).

Conflict safety relies on two mechanisms: the If-Match vs content-derived ETag check (precondition) and EventService::update's expected_version optimistic concurrency (atomicity). Both return 412 on failure.
ETag is content-derived (etag_for_ical), so it rotates exactly when canonical content changes; the event version is a separate concurrency counter.
